answer: Give each identity a real marginal cost. Every epoch, an identity must contribute a quota of verifiable useful work — compute for a shared public task, like gradient aggregation for a communal model — before it can earn. A sybil farmer's profit depends on cheap marginal puppets, but one operator has one GPU budget: doubling the puppets doubles the hardware cost, while the network gains real work from every quota. The fable of a thousand free mouths ends; each identity must feed the shared ember of the training fire to earn its own pigment of reward.
